sonnet.problem: This story card retells verse 8 (thirtyfold, sixtyfold, hundredfold) right after cards 10 and 11 already asked about it. It only repeats what the choice cards just covered and moves nothing forward. The baker also had to answer card 11 with no setup.
The True statement (they ask Him about the parable) simply repeats card 14, which just said they come to Jesus with a question about the scene, so the answer is given away.

sonnet.problem: The baker has to complete the line "the deceitfulness of ___" with wording they haven't seen. Verse 19 hasn't been told yet, and nothing lets them reason out "wealth" over "pride" or "power".
sonnet.rule: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line. / The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.

sonnet.problem: "That line again" says verse 23 repeats a line shown earlier. The earlier card showed "He who has ears to hear, let him hear." Verse 23 reads "If anyone has ears to hear, let him hear." The words are not an exact match.
sonnet.rule: What he points out must be true. "Same words" means an exact match. He only points back to words a card has shown.
